name: CDC WONDER
tagline: CDC epidemiology query API for mortality, natality, and other public health datasets
description: CDC WONDER (Wide-ranging Online Data for Epidemiologic Research) provides access to CDC public health datasets—including mortality, natality, cancer, and environmental data—via a web-based query system and SOAP/XML API. Developers can submit structured requests to retrieve aggregated statistical tables for research, surveillance, and health analytics.

auth.details: No API key required for public WONDER datasets; requests are unauthenticated SOAP/XML POSTs to dataset-specific endpoints.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public access; no paid plans. Usage subject to fair-use / automated query limits (not a published free-tier quota).

rate_limits: not published as fixed req/day; CDC restricts automated bulk querying and may block excessive use
use_cases: query US mortality rates by cause of death and geography
retrieve natality statistics by state and year
export CDC cancer incidence aggregates for a county
pull environmental or vaccine-related public health tables
build epidemiology dashboards from official CDC aggregates
